messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGE fired — PagerDuty P1: latency.p99 > 1.2s in us-west (service=inference-serve). PD alert: https://pd.company/incidents/PD-7890

sam-oncall: acked. I'm on it. pulling up dashboards — grafana: https://grafana.company/d/abcd/latency-overview

maria-eng: thanks. quick note — we pushed batching v2 to canary in us-west ~5m ago, rollouts at 80%. could be related.

devendra: kvcache.evictions spiked at the same time: logs show ~230 evictions/s and tokenization backlog growing. snippet from logs: `kvcache.evictions=230/s, token_queue_len=1200`

lee-sre: can we route traffic to dedicated pool or rollback batching? ops-bot, any quick scaling options?

ops-bot: runbook: scale-dedicated-pool — executed by sam-oncall via infra CLI. command: `infractl pool scale --region us-west --pool inference-dedicated --delta +2`

sam-oncall: ran scale command +2 GPUs to inference-dedicated in us-west. also throttling non-critical background evals.

maria-eng: initiating immediate rollback of batching v2 to v1 on canary. command: `deploy rollback batching-service --to v1 --region us-west`

devendra: kicked off cache prewarm job to restore KV hit rate: `jobs/prewarm-kvcache --region us-west --target 500k`

sam-oncall: p99 dropped from ~1400ms -> 430ms within 90s after scale + rollback. still monitoring.

lee-sre: nice. any customer-facing impact detected? SLO burn estimate?

maria-eng: short spike affected ~2% of requests in the region. billing queries show a small increase in latency errors for long-context sessions. no obvious error-rate increase (5xx stable).

devendra: rough SLO burn calc: 0.02 * (p99_excess_ms ~1100ms) => short-lived but measurable. adding to incident ticket.

sam-oncall: PD incident acknowledged -> acknowledged by oncall, no escalation needed. leaving the channel open for 15m to watch for recurrence.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-7890 status: acknowledged by sam-oncall.

maria-eng: after rollback and prewarm, KV hit-rate back to normal, eviction rate down to ~12/s.

sam-oncall: p99 now stable ~260ms for the last 5m. I'll hand off in 10m to morning oncall. opening an incident doc: https://docs.company/incidents/INC-1234

lee-sre: please include timeline and the batching config diff. suggest postmortem with action items: stricter canary thresholds for batch size, auto-rollback trigger on kvcache.evictions.

devendra: +1. I'll add a runbook step to prewarm on rollout and a metric alarm for eviction rate.

sam-oncall: summary for handoff -> root likely batching v2 change causing KV pressure and tokenizer backlog; mitigations: scaled dedicated pool (+2 GPUs), disabled batching v2 rollback, ran kvcache prewarm; current state: stable, monitoring.

ops-bot: PagerDuty: PD-7890 -> resolved (automated) at 1743211387

sam-oncall: marking resolved here. will postmortem tomorrow and link to INC-1234. :thumbsup:

lee-sre: thanks all — good catch and quick mitigation.

maria-eng: will follow up with rollback PR notes and safer rollout plan.

sam-oncall: handing off to @maria-eng for follow-up postmortem and to morning oncall. thread closed in 10m unless recurrence.
